verdict.rationale: Jitsu ships connector syncs that pull data into the warehouse from third-party sources using Airbyte-compatible connectors (jitsu-gh-3, jitsu-gh-4), with 300+ sources such as Google Analytics, Stripe and Postgres (jitsu-docs-67). Syncs run as Kubernetes CronJobs, alert on failure (jitsu-docs-41, jitsu-docs-65), and Segment data can also be fed in via webhook (jitsu-docs-6). A community user confirms most major ad sources are available but says setup takes more work than Segment (jitsu-comm-6). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party connector docs covering scheduling and incremental sync behavior, independent hands-on corroboration of sync reliability, and a lower implementation bar (self-hosted syncs require Kubernetes).
